about_the_game:
A set of basic materials that can be used for a variety of purposes, such as modifying weapons and armor, your ship, preparing medicines, and making bento boxes.

Basic Craft Materials x500
Basic Medicine Materials x500
Basic Beast Materials x500
Basic Ingredients x500

*Can also be obtained in-game.
*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*Please note that all items in excess of the maximum amount will be lost.
